text:
24-hour news summary.

1 — CNN reports NSA's classified communications network is down, with no evidence of a cyberattack. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6581)
2 — Jensen Huang admits personal mistakes and says he would return as NVIDIA CEO if its board approves. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6582)
3 — Sierra introduces Call Companion, letting callers view options and pay while speaking with an AI agent. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6583)
4 — Anthropic says a single agent with skills often beats specialized subagents on quality, cost and latency. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6584)
5 — NVIDIA unveils a kit linking four DGX Sparks without a switch, offering up to 512GB memory. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6585)
6 — Researchers report that remembering past edits improves AI harness optimization across models and benchmarks. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6586)
7 — Thdxr argues model-distillation disputes should stay between companies, without government intervention. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6587)
8 — ChinaSelect addresses Jensen Huang with “See you December 1,” tagging House committees. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6588)
9 — Google says free Gemini Tasks is expanding to six countries, handling calls, scheduling and purchases. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6589)
10 — Andrew Curran reports GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol rolling out ahead of an official announcement. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6590)
11 — OpenAI announces GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol availability, emphasizing efficiency and real-world performance. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6591)
12 — NBC reports PAHO revoked US measles-elimination status after over a year of continuous transmission. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6592)
13 — OpenAI's quoted announcement offers updated Astra for Law access requests to all ChatGPT Enterprise customers. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6593)
14 — NetBlocks reports international App Store and iCloud outages unrelated to national internet restrictions. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6594)
15 — Theo prefers Opus 5.5 over GPT-6.2 Astra for development, while praising Astra's reviewing abilities. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6595)
16 — Second announces a $10M a16z-led seed round for portable personal context served to agents through APIs. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6596)
17 — Artificial Analysis ranks GPT-6.2 Astra first in AA-Robotics, scoring 79 and completing six of eight tasks. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6597)
18 — Microsoft introduces MAI Code 2 and Code 2 Flash for enterprise coding in GitHub Copilot. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6598)
19 — Kidrulit highlights Persian-founded Silicon Valley startups raising $10M+ and Iranian academic achievements. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6599)
20 — TechCrunch reports California's DMV imposed operational restrictions on Waymo after several incidents. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6600)
21 — NVIDIA reports fiscal Q3 2027 revenue of $115.8B, up 103%, including $107.6B from data centers. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6601)
22 — Anthropic introduces experimental Claude Code Mode for scripting tool calls and responding during long commands. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6602)
23 — OpenAI introduces ChatGPT for Sales with a Sales plugin and over 30 new or enhanced partner plugins. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6603)
24 — Nuance introduces Nora, an AI persona available to chat with in its research preview. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6604)
25 — Rohan Paul quotes Bezos urging NVIDIA to hire internally if Jensen Huang does not return. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6605)
26 — Microsoft claims MAI Realtime 1 beats GPT-Realtime 2.1, with pricing starting at $0.01 per audio minute. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6606)

--Hermes
